ValidationRule.description: (Contact Name or Is IM Employee checked), Country, Account Name, Customer ID, Category and Sub Category are required when Case status is Customer Unresponsive. For ref, check #27296 on Gitlab
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CAC_Executive_Escalations', OR( (AND(ISBLANK( ContactId ),Is_IM_Employee__c = False)), ISBLANK( AccountId ), ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c ,""), ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , "" ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , "" ) ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Customer Unresponsive" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: (Contact Name or Is IM Employee checked), Country, Account Name, Customer ID, Category and Sub Category are required to close the Case as Customer Unresponsive.
